author: Ruby Dev SRL
description: BroHub is the shared admin shell: one mount point, one layout, one sidebar and one place to configure who is signed in. Each Bro gem registers its pages and shows up as a section. Sections only appear for people who may use them.

author: Ruby Dev SRL
description: Records Rails console sessions (who, why, what), asks for a justification before sensitive data is touched, blocks tampering and risky methods, and ships a mountable engine where auditors review sessions. One gem instead of console1984 plus audits1984.
